ns2:section.sectionText: Great American Junk: Popular Writing in the American Renaissance, 3 hours. The 1820s and 30s saw the emergence of mass production not just of things like shoes and hats but of that far more esoteric commodity: the book. This course will explore this historical explosion in print culture, with special attention to the question of how and why some of these texts came to be deemed examples of "high" culture while others came to be thought of as "junk" -- or "low" culture. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
